tasks.title: Orchard Row Harvest
tasks.prompt:

A harvest crew picks crates from trees but cannot pick from two trees that are adjacent (picking tree i forbids picking tree i-1 and tree i+1). Best: <maximum crates>

After all 6 books, print the height of each shelf.

tasks.title: Museum Ticket Kiosk Code

Write a program that prints one line per group in the order given, with the group size, the three intermediate values a, b, c, and the final code formatted as a 3-digit number (pad with leading zeros if needed).

name: Orchid, need: 600
name: Basil, need: 250
